verdict.rationale: Convex calls itself a reactive database and advertises real-time sync so users instantly see the latest data, plus client libraries for building live-updating apps across major frameworks. The CLI's `--watch` flag live-updates query results, and an independent community commenter confirms that the whole query function is the unit of reactivity. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the client-side subscription API (e.g., a query hook) and of the push transport, and hands-on corroboration of UI update behavior/latency.
